snippet.title: The Aether - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The original Aether mod, updated and remastered for modern Minecraft

Download now on Modrinth and Curseforge
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/aether
https://modrinth.com/mod/aether

Development of the Aether mods is made possible by our supporters on Patreon! Consider pledging to help future development:
